headline: National currency falls against the euro but gains ground against the dollar
summary: The National Bank of Romania reported a 0.04% depreciation of the leu against the euro. The reference rate rose to 5.2542 lei from 5.2523 lei the previous day.
why: The leu is Romania's currency, and its exchange rate affects import costs, inflation and returns on lei-denominated assets. The National Bank of Romania sets the official reference rate.
